FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–12 YEARS

Extra-curricular activity flashcards.

Forty-five clubs, forty-five first steps. Each card names one activity — chess, baking, pottery, robotics — and prints the two skills the club trains under its name, from Aim & Focus to Calm & Wellbeing. The fifteen youngest-friendly clubs are tagged Ages 3+; the rest are Ages 6+. Every club has a short page, a full lesson and a printable twin in the library — pick the club, learn the skill, and let the hobby grow.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Four ways that work.

You do not need a plan or a printer schedule. Pick one idea, try it for two minutes and see what happens.

  1. 01

    One club, one week

    Pick a single card — say, chess — and give it one honest week: learn one opening trick, play three games, teach someone the rules. A week of trying beats a month of deciding.

  2. 02

    Club fair night

    Deal five cards face down. Everyone draws one, names its two skills and pitches the club to the family in one minute — then vote on the one to try first.

  3. 03

    Skill scavenger hunt

    Read a card’s skill pill — Balance & Grace, Aim & Focus — and hunt for where the family already uses it: stairs, spoons, drawing straight lines. Every club trains something the house already does.

  4. 04

    Hobby diary

    After each club try-out, one journaling page: what we did, the best moment, keep or swap. Three honest entries later, the right club picks itself.
